item.tib: khro rgyal dbyings kyi rigs lnga'i rtags sgrub
item.coloph: de ltar khro rgyal gsang ba'i rtags sgrab zhes bya ba/ slob dpon 'chi med gtsug phud kyis (kyi) thugs bcud/ zhi khro gsas mkhar rab 'byams kyi yang snying / phyi rabs gshen po rnams kyis spyod yul/ khro rgyal dbyings kyi rtags sgrub zhes bya ba/ stong (stang) chen dmu tsha gyer med kyis/ phyi rabs 'gro ba'i don ched du/ las ldan gshen la brgyud pa'o/ dge legs su 'phel bar shog/
